title: Facts at the origin, observations in Git, files on any host
description: Each layer survives without the one below it. Sites work without the index; the index rebuilds without the site; the site is served without anything running.

nodes.title: Publisher sites
nodes.detail: Each project's own site: dreamweave.json, one manifest per project, archives and mirrors. The only authority for identity and releases.

nodes.title: Crawler
nodes.detail: cargo network refresh, every six hours in CI or by hand. Discovers, validates, compares digests, fetches only what changed.

nodes.title: network-state branch
nodes.detail: Last good manifests byte for byte, per-site and per-claim records, one file per change event. Git is the history.

nodes.title: Build
nodes.detail: cargo network build, then zola build. A pure function of the state: no clock, no network.

nodes.title: Static site
nodes.detail: Pages, catalog.json, events.json, search.json, the updates feed. Any static host, any mirror.

nodes.title: network/sources.toml
nodes.detail: The reviewed list of sites to read. Changed by pull request.

nodes.title: network/curation.toml
nodes.detail: This index's own decisions: acknowledged moves, featured projects. Labelled as the index's.

nodes.title: Clients
nodes.detail: CHIMERA or anything else. Reads publisher sites directly; may use this index to find them.
